title: David and Goliath
style: Cinematic live-action biblical epic, photorealistic, ancient Israel around 1000 BC, rocky hills with olive trees and dry grass, natural golden sunlight, 35mm film look, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fabric, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no background music.

characters.DAVID: DAVID: a 16-year-old Israelite shepherd boy, slim, ruddy sun-tanned skin, curly reddish-brown shoulder-length hair, light hazel eyes, no beard, plain undyed knee-length wool tunic, brown leather belt, small leather shepherd's bag across his chest, leather sandals, wooden shepherd's staff, leather sling tucked in his belt. Voice: young, clear, earnest and brave.
characters.GOLIATH: GOLIATH: a giant Philistine warrior about nine feet tall, twice the height of other men, massive build, thick black beard, fierce dark eyes, crested bronze helmet, coat of bronze scale armour, bronze greaves on his shins, a huge spear with an iron head, a soldier carrying his tall shield walks in front of him. Voice: very deep, booming and mocking.
characters.KING_SAUL: KING SAUL: a tall king in his fifties, greying beard, tired worried eyes, thin gold crown, deep purple robe over a bronze breastplate, red cloak. Voice: older, deep, commanding but weary.
characters.JESSE: JESSE: an elderly father about seventy, long white beard, kind wrinkled face, cream head-cloth with a blue band, brown wool robe, wooden walking staff. Voice: warm, gentle, old.
characters.ELIAB: ELIAB: David's eldest brother, about 28, tall and strong, short dark beard, leather soldier's vest over a red tunic, bronze-tipped spear. Voice: harsh and irritated.
characters.ISRAELITE_SOLDIERS: ISRAELITE SOLDIERS: bearded men in leather vests and bronze helmets, spears and round wooden shields.
characters.PHILISTINE_SOLDIERS: PHILISTINE SOLDIERS: soldiers in feathered headdress helmets, round shields and short swords.
characters.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: deep, calm, warm male storyteller voice.

shots.part: Part 1 — The giant's challenge
shots.title: Two armies
shots.action: Slow aerial drone shot at sunrise over the Valley of Elah. The Israelite army stands on the hill on the left, the Philistine army on the hill on the right, hundreds of tents and banners, a dry stony brook winding through the valley between them, morning mist.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: The Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

shots.part: Part 1 — The giant's challenge
shots.title: Goliath steps out
shots.action: Low-angle shot. The Philistine ranks part and GOLIATH strides out onto the valley floor, his shield-bearer ahead of him. Each heavy step raises dust, sunlight flashes on his bronze armour, the soldiers beside him look small.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath.

shots.part: Part 1 — The giant's challenge
shots.title: The taunt
shots.action: Low-angle medium shot of GOLIATH on the valley floor, looking up toward the Israelite hill, shouting with a mocking grin, spear raised.
shots.speaker: GOLIATH
shots.line: Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? Choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me!

shots.part: Part 1 — The giant's challenge
shots.title: I defy Israel
shots.action: Close-up of GOLIATH's bearded face under the bronze helmet, he slams the butt of his spear into the ground and roars, dust shaking off the rocks.
shots.speaker: GOLIATH
shots.line: I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together!

shots.part: Part 1 — The giant's challenge
shots.title: Israel is afraid
shots.action: On the Israelite hilltop, KING SAUL and his soldiers stare down into the valley. Soldiers step back, gripping their shields, frightened faces. Slow push-in on Saul's worried face.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

shots.part: Part 2 — David goes to the camp
shots.title: The shepherd boy
shots.action: Golden-hour wide shot of green hills near Bethlehem, a flock of sheep grazing. DAVID sits on a rock with his staff, watching the sheep, then gently lifts a lamb. Stone houses of the village on the far hill.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: David was the youngest: and he returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.

shots.part: Part 2 — David goes to the camp
shots.title: Jesse's errand
shots.action: In the courtyard of a simple stone house, JESSE hands DAVID a woven basket of ten round flat loaves and a cloth sack of roasted grain. Medium two-shot, warm afternoon light.
shots.speaker: JESSE
shots.line: Take now for thy brethren this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to thy brethren.

shots.part: Part 2 — David goes to the camp
shots.title: David agrees
shots.action: Close-up of DAVID taking the basket, smiling and nodding to his father.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.line: Yes, father. I will go at first light.

shots.part: Part 2 — David goes to the camp
shots.title: The journey
shots.action: Tracking shot at dawn: DAVID walks briskly along a rocky hill path carrying the basket and sack, orange sunrise behind the hills, his breath visible in the cool air.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and went, as Jesse had commanded him.

shots.part: Part 2 — David goes to the camp
shots.title: At the camp
shots.action: Busy Israelite army camp with tents, soldiers lining up in battle ranks. DAVID sets down his basket with the supply keeper and runs to the ranks, finding ELIAB and two other brothers. He greets them happily.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.line: Brothers! Father has sent you bread and corn. How do you fare?

shots.part: Part 2 — David goes to the camp
shots.title: The soldiers flee
shots.action: GOLIATH's booming voice echoes up from the valley, he is a distant giant figure below. Panicked Israelite soldiers turn and run back past DAVID up the hill. David stands still, surprised, looking down at the giant.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.

shots.part: Part 2 — David goes to the camp
shots.title: David's question
shots.action: Close-up of DAVID, his face turning from surprise to anger, speaking to the soldiers around him, pointing down at the valley.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.line: Who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

shots.part: Part 2 — David goes to the camp
shots.title: Eliab is angry
shots.action: ELIAB pushes through the soldiers, grabs DAVID by the arm and speaks to him angrily, face close to his.
shots.speaker: ELIAB
shots.line: Why camest thou down hither? With whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride!

shots.part: Part 2 — David goes to the camp
shots.title: Is there not a cause?
shots.action: DAVID calmly pulls his arm free and looks up at his older brother, steady and unafraid.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.line: What have I now done? Is there not a cause?

shots.part: Part 3 — Before the king
shots.title: David offers to fight
shots.action: Inside King Saul's large tent, lit by oil lamps, rich red fabric walls. DAVID bows before KING SAUL, then stands tall and speaks with confidence. Generals watch in surprise.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.line: Let no man's heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

shots.part: Part 3 — Before the king
shots.title: Saul doubts him
shots.action: Medium close-up of KING SAUL shaking his head kindly but sadly, looking down at the young shepherd.
shots.speaker: KING_SAUL
shots.line: Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

shots.part: Part 3 — Before the king
shots.title: The lion (memory)
shots.action: Flashback with a soft hazy glow: moonlit pasture at night, a lion leaps into the flock and carries off a lamb. DAVID chases it with his staff, the lion drops the lamb and runs away. David lifts the lamb safely into his arms. No blood.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.line: There came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock: and I went out after him, and delivered it out of his mouth.

shots.part: Part 3 — Before the king
shots.title: The LORD will deliver me
shots.note: long line: use a 10-second clip or split it in two
shots.action: Back in the tent, close-up of DAVID speaking with deep faith, eyes shining in the lamplight.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.line: The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.

shots.part: Part 3 — Before the king
shots.title: Saul's blessing
shots.action: KING SAUL places his hand on DAVID's shoulder, a small hopeful smile.
shots.speaker: KING_SAUL
shots.line: Go, and the LORD be with thee.

shots.part: Part 3 — Before the king
shots.title: Saul's armour
shots.action: Servants dress DAVID in King Saul's armour: a bronze helmet that slips over his eyes and a heavy coat of mail far too big for him. He takes a few clumsy steps and almost stumbles. Light-hearted moment, KING SAUL watching.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.delivery: DAVID says, taking off the helmet
shots.line: I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them.

shots.part: Part 3 — Before the king
shots.title: Five smooth stones
shots.action: At a shallow brook in the valley, close-up of DAVID's hands choosing five smooth round stones from the clear running water, one by one, and dropping them into his leather shepherd's bag. He stands, sling in hand, and looks toward the giant.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: And he chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag; and his sling was in his hand.

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: Face to face
shots.action: Wide shot of the valley floor: small DAVID walks out alone with his staff and sling, GOLIATH advances toward him with his shield-bearer, both armies watching from the hills. The difference in size is huge.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and he disdained him: for he was but a youth.

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: Goliath mocks
shots.action: Low-angle shot of GOLIATH laughing scornfully down at the boy, pointing his huge spear.
shots.speaker: GOLIATH
shots.line: Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air!

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: In the name of the LORD
shots.action: Heroic close-up of DAVID, wind moving his curly hair, sun behind him, looking up at the giant without fear.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.line: Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts.

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: The battle is the LORD's
shots.action: Slow push-in on DAVID as he raises his sling toward the sky, his voice ringing across the valley, soldiers on the hillside listening.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.line: That all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel, for the battle is the LORD's!

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: David runs
shots.action: Tracking shot: DAVID runs toward GOLIATH, takes one stone from his bag, loads the sling and whirls it over his head in slow motion, dust flying from his feet.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: And David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine, and took thence a stone, and slang it.

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: The stone strikes
shots.action: Slow motion: the stone flies through the air and strikes GOLIATH on the forehead below his helmet. He freezes, eyes wide, his spear slipping from his hand. Quick and clean, no blood.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: And smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead.

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: The giant falls
shots.action: GOLIATH sways and falls face-first onto the valley floor with a huge cloud of dust and a ground-shaking thud. Both armies stare in stunned silence. DAVID stands alone with his sling.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: And he fell upon his face to the earth. So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone.

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: Israel shouts
shots.action: The Israelite army charges down the hill cheering, spears raised, while the Philistine soldiers turn and flee in panic over their hill.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines.

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: Whose son art thou?
shots.action: Abner, the army commander, leads DAVID into KING SAUL's tent. Saul rises from his throne and looks at the boy with wonder.
shots.speaker: KING_SAUL
shots.line: Whose son art thou, thou young man?

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: Son of Jesse
shots.action: Close-up of DAVID, humble and smiling, bowing his head to the king.
shots.speaker: DAVID
shots.line: I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.

shots.part: Part 4 — The battle is the LORD's
shots.title: Closing verse
shots.action: Sunset over the hills of Bethlehem. DAVID stands on a hilltop with his staff, his flock around him, golden light, slow pull back to a wide shot.
shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.line: For the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
